column1: # Bundle definitions — one-keystroke first-run UX.
# 1 = include, 0 = skip. zim/osm/whisper rows index into the corresponding TSV
# (1-based; 0 = skip). 'custom' isn't here — it drops into per-knob prompts.
# Estimated sizes assume default ZIM (Simple EN ~395 MB), default OSM (Monaco
# ~700 KB), default Whisper (small.en ~497 MB — base.en was removed upstream
# 2026-05-08), default OCR (eng ~12 MB), default TTS (sherpa+supertonic
# ~210 MB across 3 OS binaries + model).
# Keep the 'full' row in lockstep with the bash apply_baked_defaults() function
# and the PowerShell equivalent — bundle=full and -y must produce the same
# DOOM_* settings.
# Schema (tab-delimited):
#   name  label  e4b moe emb wiki osm whisper ocr docs redbean doom tts img
#         passwords ffmpeg devtools fieldmanual
#         zim_idx osm_idx whisper_idx
#         estimated_bytes  summary
# v0.5 added two toggles: redbean (the local platform layer, ~5.5 MB) and
# doom (the Dwasm bundle + shareware DOOM1.WAD, ~7.5 MB).
# v0.7 adds tts (Sherpa-ONNX runtime + Supertonic int8 model, ~210 MB).
# tts requires redbean to host the /tts route, just like doom.
# v0.10 adds img (sd.cpp + FLUX.2 klein 4B transformer + small-decoder VAE +
# Qwen3-4B Q4_K_M text encoder via --llm; ~5 GB total. Qwen3-4B doubles as
# the lightest AI core option in start.{sh,bat,command} picker).
# v0.11 adds passwords (KeePassXC GUI password manager, ~250 MB cross-OS,
# GPL-2.0+) and ffmpeg (BtbN gpl + Martin-Riedl macOS, ~210 MB cross-OS,
# GPL-3.0+). passwords is balanced+full; ffmpeg is full-only.
# v0.12 adds devtools (ripgrep/fzf/jq/7-Zip/VSCodium, ~280 MB cross-OS, MIT+LGPL-2.1)
# and fieldmanual (public-domain corpus, ~1 MB). Both are balanced+full.
# name
tiny
column2: ~5.4 GB — E4B + Simple Wikipedia, no maps or voice
column23: E4B + Simple Wikipedia. Smallest useful kit.

column1: balanced
column2: ~7.03 GB — E4B + Embed + Simple Wiki + Monaco maps + side-arms + redbean + DOOM + TTS + KeePassXC + DevTools + Field manual
column23: E4B + Embedding + Simple Wikipedia + Monaco placeholder maps + all side-arms + redbean + DOOM + TTS + KeePassXC password manager + DevTools + Field manual. Sensible default for a fresh USB.

column1: full
column2: ~29.4 GB — Everything (E4B + 26B + Embed + Qwen3-4B + side-arms + redbean + DOOM + TTS + image gen + KeePassXC + ffmpeg + DevTools + Field manual)
column23: All Gemma models + EmbeddingGemma + Qwen3-4B (image gen text encoder + 3rd AI core option) + all side-arms + redbean + DOOM + TTS + image gen + KeePassXC + ffmpeg + DevTools + Field manual. Matches today's --non-interactive defaults.
